text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O was so close to getting first place…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Alas, Trainer… I've come up short.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I could taste the victory, it was so close…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ahh, if I had been but one step faster! You could've witnessed me glimmering with the sweat of victory!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Such is life! The wind, you see, gusts in longing for my delightful presence.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Why, you look more amazed than I do when gazing in a mirror.
choice_data_list: I'm just relieved you're your usual self!
I was sure you'd be crushed by the results…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Of all the things to wonder… I remain, as always, more beautiful than all.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, Trainer! Let us return to the academy. My brilliance must be honed further still!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's get back on track!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Leave it in my capable hands! What glimmers next will not be beads of mere sweat—it shall be my gallant stride!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Light continues to shine from the heavens. Such radiance at times can force your gaze downward.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Should I avert my eyes, surely it would appear as if shadows have stricken the land. No… The crowd must see me in my full glory.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: This cannot stand! So I ask you, in what form is it right that I reveal my own self?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Look upon me, one and all! Watch as I achieve an ever more radiant light!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: By the way she endeavors to improve—unwilling to settle with today's performance—I'm certain that she shines brighter than anyone!
